required_statements.statement: The operational outcome is parcel arrival at its assigned outbound lane with identity and intended lane retained through a jam.
The five functional responsibilities are distinct from selected physical parts; physical allocation is unspecified.
warehouseControl and the operator are external to sorter.
Two physical diverter actuator occurrences share one RotaryActuator definition; occurrence identity and shared definition facts are separate.
Selected occurrence ParcelSortingStudy::sorter::diverterB::actuator has asset tag QA-DB-02 and homeAngle -8 degrees; its sibling A has QA-DA-01 and 12 degrees.
Station and warehouse endpoints have opposite exchange roles; dispatch/resume enter sorter and acknowledgement/jam reports leave sorter with the stated payloads.
The jam/recovery story is declared intent: jam reported, route dispatch held, recovery pending, operator clearance report plus warehouse resume authorisation expected before resumed sorting.
Initial R1 acknowledgement bound is 120 ms from RouteDispatch receipt; its milestone is disputed.
The one clarification confirms conflicting interpretations and leaves ACK-MEANING-01 unresolved.
R2 changes only the acknowledgement bound to 80 ms; endpoints, messages, actuator settings and acknowledgement ambiguity remain unchanged.
Change impact retains source revision/byte identity and exact anchors; explicit direct, possible and unlinked_unknown dependencies have different meanings.
Proposed retired DEP-03 remains visible for review; candidate replacement is not a recorded approved deletion or promotion.
OBS-MOCK-01 remains a fictional 95 ms message-acceptance observation in PS-MOCK-01 against R1 and retains its reported_pass_against_mock_R1_criterion result after R2 arrives.
Historical applicability needs review; the mock observation does not establish physical diversion, recovery or R2 compliance.
TP-ACK-R1 is a planned unexecuted check and integrated commissioning planning is blocked by missing setup, oracle, instrumentation/calibration applicability, conditions and authorisation.
No applicable tested timing/physical-behavior profile or approved design remedy is supplied; controlled requirement revision may coexist with unresolved design adequacy.
